views.notes: [REQUIRED] Owner CameraRig. Crash Bandicoot 3 style authored follow: Cinemachine 3 camera following the Professor with a world-space offset (0, 3.2, −6.5) m rotated by the camera-zone yaw, look target +1.0 m above the Professor, damping 0.3 s, look-ahead 0.25 s, FOV 50°. Camera zones (trigger volumes, level content) change yaw/offset with a 0.8 s ease-in-out blend; the new input basis applies when the stick drops below 0.2 or the blend ends. Key shot on OnKeySpawned (§B KeyMaterialisation). Cut (no blend) on OnPlayerRespawned. Look: none (authored).
